ground_truth.title: List of programming languages
ground_truth.main_content:
This is an index to notable programming languages, in current or historical use. Dialects of BASIC (which have their own page), esoteric programming languages, and markup languages are not included. ground_truth.main_content_markdown:
This is an index to notable [programming languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Programming_language), in current or historical use. Dialects of [BASIC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BASIC) (which have [their own page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_BASIC_dialects)), [esoteric programming languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esoteric_programming_language), and [markup languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markup_language) are not included. A programming language does not need to be [imperative](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperative_programming) or [Turing-complete](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turing_completeness), but must be [executable](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Executable) and so does not include markup languages such as [HTML](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML) or [XML](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XML), but does include [domain-specific languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domain-specific_language) such as [SQL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SQL) and its dialects.
